description_en:
Retrieves the details of a data standard word root.
Online version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
获取数据标准词根详情。
上线版本：v5.4.2
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-standard-word-root --op-tenant-id 30001011 --name '平均值' --nullable true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStandardWordRoot

parameters.description_en: The name of the word root.
parameters.help_en: The name of the word root

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to allow a null value to be returned when the word root does not exist. If set to false, an exception is thrown. Default value: true.
